summary: Overall tidy kitchen with minor fire hazard and floor rug tripping risk.

hazards.title: Towel hung on oven door handle
hazards.detail: Cloth hanging near the oven burners can catch fire or ignite when preheating.
fixSteps: Relocate fabric towels away from cooking appliances.
Use a wall hook or cabinet towel bar away from heat sources.

hazards.title: Unsecured fringed floor rug
hazards.detail: Unanchored rug edges and fringes on slick flooring cause slips and trips.
fixSteps: Place a non-skid rubber underlayment beneath the runner.
Tuck or secure fringes flat to prevent catching shoes.
